## Checklist

- [ ] Users will notice this: there is a line under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`, written for
      streamers. Users will not notice it: the pull request has the `skip-changelog` label.
- [ ] New or changed texts (panel, viewer pages, desktop app, website) are in English and Brazilian
      Portuguese.
- [ ] No telemetry, no account, no paid service and no new call home.
- [ ] No stream key, live link, token or personal data in code, tests, logs or screenshots.
